assessment: Strong problem and solution episode. The jetted tub to shower swap is the clearest homeowner story, and the finished shower carries three product beats worth their own Shorts later, the lit niche, the grain matched marble, and the heated floor. Cost talk at 1:52 to 2:10 is deliberately left out, Mike handles price with his own end slides.

opportunities.why_it_works: A jetted tub nobody wanted and a shower that was too small is a problem homeowners recognise instantly, and the payoff shot is a full walk in shower in the same footprint.

opportunities.cta_strategy: Ask if they would add one.

project_context.summary: Master bathroom remodel on the Mountaineer House. The jetted tub came out, the old corner shower became a linen cabinet, and the tub footprint became a full walk in shower with a bench, a lit niche, and a heated tile floor.
project_context.segment_choice: The Short is cut from the pre demo walkthrough at 0:34 to 1:15, the framed state at 2:45, and the finished reveal from 3:05 to 5:40. Those three states carry the whole story without any footage of work happening.
project_context.publish_order: Single Short for this episode. The lit niche and the grain matched marble are held back as follow up Shorts.
notes: On screen text is the script itself, burned in as subtitles timed to Mike's AI read.
Cost is never the closer, the price segment at 1:52 to 2:10 is deliberately unused.

shorts.full_vo:
This master bath had a big JETTED tub...and a shower that was REALLY small. The shower was tucked behind this GLASS, over in the corner.

So we took the TUB out...and turned that space into the new shower! Look at it NOW! A bench, a recessed NICHE, and an LED light right inside it.

See the GRAIN? They cut the marble so it runs right down the side...even on the threshold. And the whole tile floor is HEATED, with a programmable thermostat!

Watch the full remodel.
shorts.voice_direction: Confident and homeowner friendly, a little wry on the jetted tub line, then genuinely pleased through the reveal. Conversational, never announcer.
